description: BeatSaberRL replays for the bsrl-replay widget: lists the published replays (local replays-site manifest, latest model, best pp first), downloads them from replays.flee.systems (cached in data/bsrl-replays), decodes format-2 .rpl.gz / JSONL v10 and publishes replay.q/chart/walls/hud/torque tensors + replay.meta. Pick with replay.ctl.load = id | index | {cmd:'next'|'prev'} | {path}.
